❯ Write a story of about 3000 words about a bell founder, as plain text with no
  tools. Then stop.

● The Bell Founder's Shadow

  Marcus had been casting bells for forty-three years when the silence found
  him. Not the silence after the bell was hung, that satisfying quiet that meant
  his work was done—this was different. This was the silence of a man who no
  longer heard the world the way he once had.

  He sat in his workshop on Merchant Street, hands resting on the wooden forms
  he'd carved decades ago, thumbs tracing the familiar grooves worn smooth by
